bullets.text: Ran and inspected a supplied Python notebook to load provided public policy records for the supervised project, and edited simple filters and loops with step-by-step guidance.

Under supervision, executed and inspected supplied Python notebooks applying regular-expression and dictionary rules to extract organization and date spans from public policy excerpts, then compared extracted spans with provided manually checked examples.

Under supervision, validated SQL joins using duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks; executed and inspected supplied analysis notebooks to visualize how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.
Ran and inspected a supplied Python notebook to load provided research abstract records for the supervised project, and edited simple filters and loops with step-by-step guidance.

Under supervision, executed and inspected supplied notebooks to compare dictionary coding with nonnegative-matrix-factorization topic exploration of public research abstracts; examined topic stability across repeated fits and inspected documents supporting each interpretation.
